title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large collection of AI engineering tutorials and agent-application examples, including an MCP server (sdv-mcp) that exposes synthetic-data generation as a tool for AI agents. The sdv-mcp component imports SDV's HMASynthesizer and evaluate_quality to fit multi-table metadata, generate synthetic data, and score its quality, wrapping SDV as a callable capability for an AI agent.
needs: sdv-mcp is one subproject within a large multi-topic tutorial hub; unclear how central it is to the overall repo's purpose.
